decision.summary: NO_ACTION: keep the open 78k REACH daily_thesis position; it has not reached any valid management threshold and no second daily setup is clean enough.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Reconciliation is clean, daily_success_cooldown is inactive, and the only open BTC price-hit position is will-bitcoin-reach-78k-on-may-20 Yes in the daily_thesis slot. The latest Beecthor thesis is still stale and broadly bearish, but it explicitly mapped 78k as a meaningful rebound area, which is why the existing trade remains acceptable while Binance still shows bullish_short_term structure: spot is 77382.5, UTC day is positive, and 12h/24h momentum remain positive. There is no valid REDUCE or CLOSE trigger: the live executable sell price is only about 0.53 best bid, well below the 0.75 partial-take-profit threshold and far below the 0.90-0.95 full take-profit zone. Re-adding is not justified because the same market already uses the early-stage single-position cap. A new second daily is also not clean: 79k REACH is only around 0.125 and would require an extra extension, while the dip side conflicts with the current intraday Binance structure. The correct action is to hold.
